ns2:course.label: Plant Molecular Biology
ns2:course.description: The basic concepts and methodologies of measuring plant gene expression and gene product activity and constructing transgenic plants are presented and discussed. Serves as a gateway to specialized methodology approaches covered in IB 473, IB 474, and IB 475. Same as CPSC 462. Prerequisite: MCB 150 and IB 204; or consent of instructor.
